mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending confidence, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of triggered periods, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually), manufacturing output weakness signals reduced corporate profitability, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods where INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts trend (HOUST) over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening residential construction, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods where HOUST rises over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS) falls below 50,000 jobs, it signals labor market slowdown that reduces consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of triggered periods, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and rising), higher interest rates compress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods where FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and rising, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in manufacturing output (INDPRO) and real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate a deepening supply shock, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods where both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.
